summary: Practise IT change assessment, approval, scheduling, and review. Explore the five-day course outline and see how it fits your team.
lede: IT change management is the controlled process of assessing, authorizing, implementing, and reviewing changes to live services. For change coordinators, service desk leads, and infrastructure supervisors, training covers mapping dependencies, assessing service and security impacts, planning implementation and rollback, and recording review outcomes.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for people who assess, authorize, schedule, implement, or report changes to live IT services. It is suitable for foundation-level learners who work with service requests, configuration items, maintenance windows, and change records.
prerequisites: Basic familiarity with IT service operations is useful. No coding is required.
